title: 2018 eyetracking attention above fold and first screenfuls
statement:
NN/g's 2018 eyetracking data show about 57% of viewing time above the fold (down from 80% in 2010) and 81% within the first three screenfuls, so the fold has moved down but attention still decays steeply, and important content belongs in the first one to two screenfuls.

Options:
- CTA in screenful one: Primary CTA and value proposition in the first screenful (fits: confident, professional, conversion-focused)
- Proof in screenful two: Second screenful (about 17% of viewing time) used for reinforcing proof and the next-most important content (fits: trustworthy, authoritative)
- Essentials within three screenfuls: Essential content kept within the first three screenfuls, which held about 81% of viewing time (fits: focused, practical, minimal)
- Repeat CTA deeper down: Repeat CTA near the end of the second or third screenful for people who keep scrolling (fits: persuasive, energetic)
appliesWhen: Applies to: general web, ecommerce, media publishing. Audience: general.
